title: Off-center Fourier sum
statement: For a finite family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, a point $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, and a Boolean function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, define the off-center sum at $x$ to be $\sum_{a\in\{-1,1\}^n,\ a\ne x} f(a)K_{\mathcal F}(a,x)$, where $K_{\mathcal F}$ is the prescribed Fourier kernel.
hypotheses_covered: A finite family of subsets of Fin n
A point in the Boolean cube {−1,1}^n
A Boolean function from the cube to the signs
